verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of CLI flags or environment variables for setting GPU offload or context length when loading a model; it only covers cloud/agent integrations, REST API, and language libraries. One community report (ollama-comm-13) even states Ollama 'hides all the server configs in favor of their own sane defaults' and won't let users configure low-level options like mlock, suggesting this kind of fine-grained CLI customization is not well supported.
